name: 49315 · Byron Center, MI
findings: ZIP 49315 (Byron Center) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49315 (Byron Center) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49315 (Byron Center) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
